info.subtitle: Dataset for detecting Real vs AI-generated speech
info.description:
# Audio Deepfake Detection Dataset

Classification dataset for detecting real vs synthetic/AI-generated speech audio.

## Dataset Details
- **Total samples:** 4,447 WAV files (16kHz)
- **Real samples:** 2,274 authentic human speech recordings
- **Fake samples:** 2,173 AI-generated/synthetic speech

## Use Cases
- Deepfake audio detection
- Speech authenticity verification
- Voice cloning detection
- Synthetic speech classification

## Format
- Audio: 24kHz WAV files

## Model Training
Suitable for fine-tuning models like:
- Wav2Vec2
- HuBERT
- XLSR
- Audio classification transformers
